aerial_recon.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery. Remaining time caps how far you can draw (speed × remaining). Flight time is drawn length ÷ speed. Sites within flight discovery distance are rolled at the listed chance.

aerial_scout.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery. Remaining time caps how far you can draw (speed × remaining). Flight time is drawn length ÷ speed. Sites within flight discovery distance are rolled at the listed chance.

blackout_cover.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use covers one discovered site until you stop or time runs out. While active, multiplies rival_discovery by 0.5 (halves other players' discovery chance on that site). You gain successful site disguise XP only when a rival's roll would have discovered the site without this cover, but the cover stops them — not when they miss anyway, and not when they discover it despite the cover. One disguise at a time.

brush_scrim.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use covers one discovered site until you stop or time runs out. While active, multiplies rival_discovery by 0 (camouflages the site so rivals cannot discover it). Discovery rolls still run so that a would-have-hit awards you successful site disguise XP; you get nothing if their roll would have missed without the cover. One disguise at a time.

canyon_throttle.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. While active, raises max discovery speed by 300% so motorcycle travel still counts toward discovery distance, but discover visibility, walk-in chance, and site exploration radius drop 15%.

expedition_drivetrain.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. While active, raises max discovery speed by 200% so bicycle travel still counts toward discovery distance, but discover visibility, walk-in chance, and site exploration radius drop 10%.

formation_map.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. Colors a fixed square of the map by rock type. Higher accuracy sharpens rock-type boundaries; the outer edge has a slight fixed soft fade. Wideness sets the side length (500 m–2 km) on the same 500 m grid used for field sites, locked to this tool occurrence.

geo_compass.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. Shows a direction range toward the nearest undiscovered site; lower exactness widens the glow. Walk-in discovery of that nearest site uses the listed chance instead of the base rate.

nocturne_lens.stats_explanation: Lifetime battery; only starts and runs at night. Boosts visibility range and walk-in discovery chance by 40%. Stops automatically when night ends (dawn / day / dusk).

orbit_survey.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. Colors the map by the period of nearby undiscovered field sites. Higher accuracy sharpens boundaries; higher range widens the circle (200 m–2 km).

overland_chassis.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. While active, raises max discovery speed by 400% so 4x4 travel still counts toward discovery distance, but discover visibility, walk-in chance, and site exploration radius drop 20%.

proximity_scanner.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. Shows distance to the nearest undiscovered site as meter bands; lower exactness uses coarser rounding (up to 200 m), higher is finer (down to 1 m).

ridge_glass.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. While active, boosts site visibility range and walk-in discovery chance, and decreases max discovery speed for all sites.

site_navigator.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. Combines a direction-range glow and distance bands for the nearest undiscovered site, with the listed walk-in discovery chance for that site.

terrain_echo.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery (editable within min/max); each use runs on whatever time remains until you stop or it runs out. Rotating survey pulse around your position. Blips mark nearby sites you have not discovered yet. Higher accuracy tightens blips; range sets pulse radius (20–200 m).

trail_striders.stats_explanation: Duration is this card's lifetime battery; each use runs until you stop or time runs out. While active, raises max discovery speed by 100% so a fast jog still counts toward discovery distance, but discover visibility, walk-in chance, and site exploration radius drop 5%.
